endorsements.name: Marton Illes
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-20989
endorsements.description: Fibaro Home Center 2 and Lite devices with firmware version 4.600 and older initiate SSH connections to the Fibaro cloud to provide remote access and remote support capabilities. This connection can be intercepted using DNS spoofing attack and a device initiated remote port-forward channel can be used to connect to the web management interface. Knowledge of authorization credentials to the management interface is required to perform any further actions.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.9)
